name: UINav: A Practical Approach to Train On-Device Automation Agents
notes: The annotation was reviewed against the ACL Anthology landing page and proceedings PDF. Screens are represented from the Android accessibility tree or from pixel-based screen understanding, chosen by heuristics. Evaluation uses the public MoTIF dataset and a demonstration study of 43 tasks across 128 Android apps and websites. This record follows the publisher edition of the work; an arXiv preprint is 2312.10170.
summary: Trains small Android automation agents from demonstrations, using macro actions with status checks, demonstration augmentation, and a referee model that predicts task completion to guide further demonstrations.
